a-white-firing-georgia-kaolin-that-1k8rp: Georgia kaolin na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, nke ndị na-ere ihe na US na-edebezi n''ọnọdụ EPK. an-air-floated-georgia-kaolin-and-1f3wll: Georgia kaolin e ji ikuku kewaa (air-floated), kaolin kacha nwee plasticity a na-erekarị na North America. Ọ na-enyere aka ijide glaze n''ime mmiri mana ọ bụghị thixotropic dịka EPK, TiO2 ya (1.4%) na-emekwa ka ọ ghara ịcha ọcha dịka EPK mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ.
a-fine-plastic-kentucky-ball-clay-1l3mfw: Kentucky ball clay dị nro ma nwee plasticity, ''ball clay'' a na-ejikarị na US n''usoro glaze na usoro ahụ ite. Na glaze ọ na-agbakwunye alumina na silica ma na-enyere aka ijide glaze mmiri (slurry); ọ na-acha off-white ruo buff mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ n''ihi iron na titanium ya.
a-325-mesh-calcined-kaolin-made-843pbe: Calcined kaolin 325-mesh e mere maka agba (paint), nke ndị na-ere ihe ite na US na-ere dịka calcined kaolin ha. Jiri ya dochie akụkụ nke raw kaolin na glaze nwere ọtụtụ ụrọ iji belata mbelata mgbe ọ na-akpọ nkụ (drying shrinkage) na crawling.
kaolin-fired-to-drive-off-its-47owxv: Kaolin a gbara ọkụ iji chụpụ mmiri kemịkal ya, nwere otu kemistri ahụ dịka kaolin ma LOI apụọ. Usoro dere naanị ''calcined kaolin'' nwere ike iji nke a.
a-red-burning-iron-rich-ohio-91msbo: Ụrọ earthenware si Ohio nwere ọtụtụ iron, na-acha uhie mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, e ji ikuku kewaa ruo 200 mesh. Na glaze ọ bụ isi iyi iron (ihe dị ka 7% Fe2O3) na alkali, a na-eji ya ruo 60% n''ụfọdụ glaze na-acha nchara nchara na glaze ụdị slip.
a-plastic-cream-burning-southern-ohio-d7: Ụrọ stoneware si ndịda Ohio nwere plasticity, na-acha cream mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, e ji ikuku kewaa ruo 200 mesh. Ọ bụkarị ụrọ maka ahụ ite; na glaze ọ na-enye alumina na silica ya na ụfọdụ iron na titanium.
contains-crystalline-silica-quartz-do-no: O nwere crystalline silica (quartz); ekula uzuzu ya. O nwere ụfọdụ sulfur.
a-plastic-buff-firing-missouri-fireclay-: Fireclay si Missouri nwere plasticity, na-acha buff mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, a na-ere ya n''ụdị egweri 20, 35, 40 na 50 mesh. Ọ bụkarị ụrọ maka ahụ ite; ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị a bụ ndị a na-ahụkarị maka ụrọ dị n''okike.
a-blended-iron-bearing-slip-clay-1wfl7qj: Slip clay nwere iron e gwakọtara, nke Plainsman na-emepụta kemgbe 1988 dịka ihe nnọchi Albany slip. Naanị ya, ọ na-agbaze ghọọ nchara nchara na-egbuke egbuke na cone 10 (tenmoku na reduction) ma chọọ ihe dị ka 20% frit na cone 6; jiri ngwakọta nke a ṅara n''ọkụ na nke a na-aṅaghị n''usoro nwere pasent dị elu iji zere mgbawa mgbe ọ na-akpọ nkụ.
a-silty-iron-rich-new-york-oucatm: Ụrọ New York nwere silt na ọtụtụ iron, nke gbazere naanị ya ghọọ glaze nchara nchara gbara ọchịchịrị na-egbuke egbuke na cone 8 ruo 10, ọ dịkwa n''ọtụtụ puku usoro ochie. Emepụtabeghị ya kemgbe ngwụcha afọ 1980; jiri Alberta Slip n''ọnọdụ ya.
leadless-low-alumina-calcium-sodium-boro: Calcium-sodium borosilicate frit na-enweghị lead, nwere alumina dị ala; frit a na-ejikarị n''usoro glaze North America, karịsịa dịka isi iyi boron na calcium. Fusion 1450 F, flow 1600 F, CTE 9.47 (Ferro 2008).
non-hazardous-glass-powder-per-supplier-: Ntụ iko na-enweghị ihe ize ndụ dịka SDS onye na-ere ya si kwuo; zere iku uzuzu.
calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-a-balance: Calcium borosilicate frit nwere kemistri kwụ ọtọ dịka glaze (o nwere ihe dị ka 10% alumina); ya na ntakịrị kaolin, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ glaze low-fire zuru oke. Fusion 1600 F, flow 1750 F, CTE 7.94 (Ferro 2008).
high-sodium-low-boron-high-expansion-ggm: Frit nwere sodium dị elu, boron dị ala na mgbasa dị elu; isi iyi soda a na-ejikarị n''okpomọkụ niile na na crystalline glaze. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 10.08 (Ferro 2008).
well-balanced-high-boron-calcium-borosil: Calcium borosilicate frit kwụ ọtọ nke ọma, nwere boron dị elu; ihe dị ka 85 frit na 15 kaolin na-eme glaze cone 04 doro anya. Fusion 1500 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 7.16 (Ferro 2008).
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit na-enweghị alkali, nwere mgbasa n''okpomọkụ dị nnọọ ala (CTE ihe dị ka 4.0); a na-eji ya na 3-10% iji gwọọ crazing na dịka isi iyi MgO na-agbaze n''okpomọkụ dị ala. Fusion 1900 F, flow 2300 F (Ferro 2003).
high-alkali-almost-calcium-free-alkali-3: Alkali borosilicate frit nwere alkali dị elu, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka o nweghị calcium, nwere ntakịrị zinc na fluorine; mgbasa dị elu, a na-eji ya maka glaze crackle na glaze agba alkaline. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1500 F, CTE 9.98 (Ferro 2008).
contains-about-1-5-fluorine-which-q7b1ho: O nwere ihe dị ka 1.5% fluorine, nke nwere ike ịpụta mgbe a na-agba ọkụ; mee ka ikuku si na kiln pụọ. Ma ọ bụghị ya, ọ bụ ntụ iko nwere obere ihe ize ndụ.
artware-flux-calcium-borosilicate-frit-f: Calcium borosilicate frit, flux maka artware; ihe Fusion dere dịka onye nhata Vibrantz 3134. Ma e jiri ya tụnyere 3134-2 (Ferro 2008): Al2O3 -1.20, B2O3 +1.01, SiO2 -0.56, CaO +0.49, Na2O +0.26 points; ọ na-agbaze ma na-asọ ntakịrị karịa.
boro-calcium-dinnerware-frit-fusion-s-lb: Boro-calcium frit maka efere nri; ihe Fusion dere dịka onye nhata Vibrantz 3124. Ma e jiri ya tụnyere 3124-2 (Ferro 2008): B2O3 +0.86, K2O -0.68 (ọ dịghị na F-19), Na2O +0.60, SiO2 -0.44, Al2O3 -0.31 points; ọ na-asọ ntakịrị karịa.
high-calcium-boron-leadless-frit-fusion-: Frit boron na-enweghị lead, nwere calcium dị elu; ihe Fusion dere dịka onye nhata Vibrantz 3195. Ọ bụ nke kacha ghara ịbụ kpọmkwem n''ime nhata ndị a: ma e jiri ya tụnyere 3195-2 (Ferro 2008) o nwere K2O +3.70, Na2O -2.69, B2O3 -2.32, Al2O3 +1.52, CaO -0.86, SiO2 +0.65 points.
high-sodium-low-boron-frit-fusion-16l28b: Frit nwere sodium dị elu, boron dị ala; ihe Fusion dere dịka onye nhata Vibrantz 3110, ọ bụkwa nke kacha nso n''ime nhata ndị a: oxide ọ bụla dị n''ime 0.26 points nke 3110-2 (Ferro 2008). Ọ na-asọ ntakịrị karịa, surface tension ya dịkwa ala karịa.
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit na-enweghị alkali, nwere mgbasa dị nnọọ ala (CTE 3.96), a na-eji alụso crazing ọgụ; ihe Fusion dere dịka onye nhata Vibrantz 3249. Ma e jiri ya tụnyere 3249 o nweghị CaO (-3.50 points), SiO2 +2.40, B2O3 +1.30, Al2O3 -0.80, MgO +0.60.
natural-sodium-calcium-borate-ore-colema: Nkume sodium-calcium borate dị n''okike (colemanite na ulexite ya na ụrọ yiri hectorite), nke bụ boron flux kacha mkpa maka low-fire na mid-fire n''usoro US ogologo oge. E mechiri ebe a na-egwu ya na 2000; ihe fọdụrụ dị ole na ole ma dị oke ọnụ, Gillespie Borate bụkwa ihe nnọchi a na-atụ aro, pound maka pound.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-kpnwt9: Borate: eloola ya; nnyocha e mere n''anụmanụ ji ọnụọgụ inorganic borate dị elu (high dose) gosiri mmetụta n''ịmụ nwa/n''uto nwa (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Zere iku uzuzu. Onye na-ere ya na-enye ịdọ aka na ntị California Prop 65 banyere crystalline silica.
blended-borate-mainly-ulexite-with-some-: Borate e gwakọtara (karịsịa ulexite ya na ụfọdụ colemanite na ihe dị ka 10% ihe yiri ụrọ) e mere dịka ihe nnọchi Gerstley Borate, pound maka pound; a na-emepụta ya ma na-ere ya ugbu a na US, UK na Europe.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-havqf3: Borate: eloola ya; nnyocha e mere n''anụmanụ ji ọnụọgụ inorganic borate dị elu (high dose) gosiri mmetụta n''ịmụ nwa/n''uto nwa (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Zere iku uzuzu.
legacy-blended-gerstley-borate-substitut: Ihe nnọchi Gerstley Borate ochie e gwakọtara nke Laguna rere n''afọ 2000 gaa n''ihu; debe ya naanị maka usoro ochie. Ọ chọrọ akụkụ 6-8 bentonite ma ọ bụ hectorite n''ime 100 iji jide glaze n''ime mmiri dịka Gerstley Borate; Gillespie Borate bụ ihe nnọchi nke ugbu a.
laguna-withdrew-it-in-2012-its-13jz0u3: Laguna kwụsịrị ya na 2012: n''ọnwa May ahụ, e ji ozi dochie akwụkwọ nchekwa ya, nke kwuru na ebe Gerstley Borate dịzi ọtụtụ ọzọ, Laguna Borate adịghịzi.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-13mdgfk: Borate: eloola ya; nnyocha e mere n''anụmanụ ji ọnụọgụ inorganic borate dị elu (high dose) gosiri mmetụta n''ịmụ nwa/n''uto nwa (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Zere iku uzuzu. MSDS nke Laguna dere crystalline silica na calcium carbonate.
legacy-plastic-gerstley-borate-substitut: Ihe nnọchi Gerstley Borate ochie nwere plasticity nke Plainsman Clays mepụtara na 2000 ma ree na mmalite afọ 2000; anaghịzi emepụta ya. Debe ya naanị maka usoro ochie; Gillespie Borate bụ ihe nnọchi nke ugbu a.
plainsman-s-materials-page-listed-it-388: Ibe ihe eji arụ ọrụ nke Plainsman dere ya ruo ngwụcha 2017, ma o deghịzi ya na January 2018.
commercial-turkish-sodium-calcium-borate: Nkume sodium-calcium borate si Turkey a na-ere n''ahịa, e gweriri egweri (ụdị 75 na 45 micron); isi iyi boron a na-akwadoghị nke ndị ọkpụ ite Europe na Russia na-ejikarị, na n''ihe nnọchi Gerstley Borate e mere n''ụlọ. Ọ na-agbaze ntakịrị na mmiri, ọ na-efukwa ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n''ụzọ atọ nke ịdị arọ ya mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-1q1jdvy: Borate: eloola ya; nnyocha e mere n''anụmanụ ji ọnụọgụ inorganic borate dị elu (high dose) gosiri mmetụta n''ịmụ nwa/n''uto nwa (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Zere iku uzuzu. SDS nke Etimine (rev. Oct 2021) dere na edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru UN GHS.
aluminum-hydroxide-powder-used-to-add-8q: Ntụ aluminum hydroxide e ji agbakwunye alumina na glaze, na na kiln wash na wadding; ọ na-anọ n''ime mmiri ma na-arapara nke ọma karịa calcined alumina. Ọ na-efu ihe dị ka 35% nke ịdị arọ ya dịka mmiri n''ihe dị ka 220-300 C.
low-hazard-avoid-breathing-dust-18o1ah: Obere ihe ize ndụ; zere iku uzuzu.
calcined-aluminum-oxide-ground-to-325-43: Calcined aluminum oxide e gweriri ruo -325 mesh; ọ na-eguzogide ọkụ nke ukwuu (na-agbaze n''ihe dị ka 2040 C), a na-eji ya eme ka glaze ghara ịgbuke (matte) ma sie ike, na na kiln wash. Naanị ụdị dị nnọọ nro na-agbaze kpamkpam n''ime glaze.
low-hazard-nuisance-dust-avoid-breathing: Uzuzu na-enye nsogbu, obere ihe ize ndụ; zere iku ya.
blended-cornish-china-clay-from-imerys-6: Cornish china clay e gwakọtara si Imerys, nwere titania dị nnọọ obere na ihe dị ka 2% K2O, ya mere ọ na-acha ọcha nwere ntakịrị blue mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ. Ọ bụ kaolin a na-ejikarị n''ahụ porcelain UK na n''ọtụtụ usoro glaze UK.
fine-dust-may-contain-traces-of-1caabb5: Uzuzu dị nro; o nwere ike inwe ntakịrị crystalline silica.
imerys-cornish-china-clay-with-more-1xib: Cornish china clay nke Imerys nwere plasticity karịa, na iron na potash dị ntakịrị obere karịa Grolleg; ọ na-acha ọcha nke ukwuu mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ. E mere ya maka ahụ porcelain, a na-ejikwa ya na glaze dịka kaolin ọ bụla.
imerys-calcined-cornish-china-clay-about: Calcined Cornish china clay nke Imerys (ihe dị ka 55% mullite, 45% iko). Ụdị dị nro na-anọchi akụkụ nke raw clay na glaze nwere ọtụtụ ụrọ iji belata mbelata na crawling, ma na-eme ka okpomọkụ ọ na-eto ruo (maturing temperature) rịa ntakịrị.
high-silica-devon-ball-clay-with-all38y: Devon ball clay nwere silica dị elu, plasticity dị mma, ike nọ n''etiti na iron dị ala; ọ na-acha ivory buff mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ. Ball clay a na-ahụkarị na glaze na slip UK.
dorset-ball-clay-with-high-strength-cu8i: Dorset ball clay nwere ike dị elu na iron dị elu nke ọma (ihe dị ka 2.3% Fe2O3), a na-eji ya n''ahụ stoneware na-acha agba na-ekpo ọkụ, na n''ụfọdụ glaze na slip UK.
low-plasticity-white-firing-ball-clay-2z: Ball clay nwere plasticity dị ala, na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, nke Potclays na-ere, a ma ama n''ahụ stoneware; ọ na-acha ọcha karịa TWVA mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ.
blend-of-medium-plasticity-white-firing-: Ngwakọta ball clay nwere plasticity nọ n''etiti, na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ. Potclays na-ere ya dịka ihe nnọchi ESVA ball clay, nke ndị na-emepụta ya kwụsịrị.
potclays-potash-feldspar-almost-no-soda-: Potash feldspar nke Potclays: ọ fọrọ nke nta ka o nweghị soda, o nwekwara free silica karịrị, ya mere alumina ya dị obere karịa ọtụtụ potash spar. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị a bụ etiti nke ọnụ ọgụgụ e bipụtara.
long-standing-uk-catalogue-figures-for-q: Ọnụ ọgụgụ katalọgụ UK ochie maka potash feldspar, nke Potterycrafts, Bath Potters na CTM bipụtara. Bath Potters kwuru na potash feldspar ya si Norway.
potterycrafts-data-sheet-for-p3296-octob: Akwụkwọ data Potterycrafts maka P3296 (October 2025) na-enye nyocha Norflux K 11 nke Sibelco kama (K₂O 11.8, Na₂O 2.9), ya mere ihe ọ na-ere ugbu a nwere ike ịbụ feldspar ahụ: lee Norflux Potash Feldspar.
valentine-clays-potash-feldspar-a-typica: Potash feldspar nke Valentine Clays, potash spar a na-ahụkarị nwere ihe dị ka 10.4% K2O na 2.3% Na2O.
spanish-sodium-feldspar-albite-with-almo: Sodium feldspar si Spain (albite) nke ọ fọrọ nke nta ka o nweghị potash, nke Potclays, Potterycrafts na Valentine na-ere na otu nyocha ahụ. Flux siri ike karịa ma na-agbaze n''okpomọkụ dị ala karịa potash feldspar.
the-soda-feldspar-figures-printed-by-pm7: Ọnụ ọgụgụ soda feldspar nke Bath Potters na CTM bipụtara; Bath Potters kwuru na ọ si Norway.
mixed-potash-soda-feldspar-about-7-uyikr: Potash-soda feldspar agwakọtara (ihe dị ka 7% K2O, 5% Na2O) si ebe flotation Sibelco dị na Finland. Nke a bụ ''FFF'' nke Potclays, Potterycrafts, Valentine na CTM na-ere; aha ahụ pụtara Finnish Flotation Feldspar.
finnish-feldspar-quartz-pegmatite-that-p: Feldspar-quartz pegmatite si Finland nke Potclays na-ere dịka ihe ọzọ maka Forshammar feldspar nke na-adịghịzi. Silica ya dị elu na-eme ka ọ na-akpa àgwà dịka Cornish stone karịa ezigbo feldspar.
the-nepheline-syenite-sold-in-the-1x77jq: Nepheline syenite a na-ere na UK si Norway, nwere K2O na Na2O hà nhata. Usoro US na-eche A270 si Canada (K2O 4.8, Na2O 10.5), ya mere a pụghị iji otu dochie nke ọzọ ma a gụghachighị ya.
fine-dust-low-in-free-silica-1tgmsj5: Uzuzu dị nro; free silica ya dị ala mana zere iku ya.
natural-cornish-stone-is-no-longer-1o4yc: A naghịzi egwu Cornish stone dị n''okike, ya mere ndị na-ere ihe na UK na-ere ihe nnọchi ugbu a. FCS2 nke Valentine bụ ''flux agwakọtara e gweriri, e mere ka o kwekọọ n''àgwà ịgba ọkụ nke Cornish Stone''; ọ na-agbaze na 1100-1300 °C.
the-leadless-frit-most-used-in-r48r5w: Frit na-enweghị lead a kacha eji na glaze earthenware UK: calcium borosilicate nwere ihe dị ka 19% B2O3. Okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 900-1050 °C (Bath Potters) ma ọ bụ 950-1150 °C (Potclays).
not-classified-ctm-standard-borax-frit-1: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (CTM Standard Borax Frit SDS 36, e ji dịka onye nhata); zere iku uzuzu ya.
potterycrafts-standard-borax-frit-a-gene: Standard borax frit nke Potterycrafts, frit na-enweghị lead maka ọrụ niile n''ime glaze earthenware. Mgbasa 8.3 x 10^-6/°C, okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2953-u: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Potterycrafts SDS P2953; quartz erughị 1%); iku uzuzu ya ogologo oge na-eme ka ọrịa ngụgụ dịkwuo nso.
soft-fluid-high-expansion-alkaline-frit-: Alkaline frit dị nro, na-asọ asọ, nwere mgbasa dị elu maka glaze crackle na raku, na alkaline copper blue. Mgbasa 13.4 x 10^-6/°C, okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 880-1060 °C.
contains-barium-about-7-bao-soluble-1xab: O nwere barium (ihe dị ka 7% BaO); alkaline frit na-agbaze na mmiri, zere iloda ya.
newer-uk-high-alkaline-frit-with-1swirl0: High alkaline frit UK ọhụrụ karịa nwere soda na potash fọrọ obere ka ha hà nhata (ihe dị ka 17% nke ọ bụla) na-enweghị barium; maka glaze crackle na copper blue. Okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 860-1060 °C.
very-soluble-alkaline-frit-avoid-ingesti: Alkaline frit na-agbaze nke ukwuu na mmiri; zere iloda ya.
sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-about-25-a: Sodium borosilicate frit nwere ihe dị ka 25% B2O3 ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka o nweghị lime, a na-atụ aro ya maka glaze copper turquoise. Mgbasa 6.9 x 10^-6/°C, okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2961-b: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Potterycrafts SDS P2961); iku uzuzu ya ogologo oge na-eme ka ọrịa ngụgụ dịkwuo nso.
uk-fritted-calcium-borate-used-in-nlgcqo: Calcium borate e mere frit na UK, a na-eji n''ọnọdụ colemanite ma ọ bụ Gerstley borate (ihe dị ka 50% B2O3, 26.5% CaO). Mgbasa 6.1 x 10^-6/°C, okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 1050-1160 °C. Ọ dị n''ụlọ ahịa Potterycrafts n''October 2026.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2954-b: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Potterycrafts SDS P2954); iku uzuzu ya ogologo oge na-eme ka ọrịa ngụgụ dịkwuo nso.
potclays-calcium-borate-frit-long-establ: Calcium borate frit nke Potclays, ''nke e ji dochie colemanite na glaze kemgbe ogologo oge''. Frit dị mmiri mmiri ma dị ọkọ; okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 800-1100 °C, ọ bụghị maka ịgba ọkụ ngwa ngwa.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (SDS Potterycrafts P2954 nhata ya; akwụkwọ calcium borate frit nke Bath Potters kwuru na ọ dịghị mkpa itinye ya akara); zere iku uzuzu ya.
ctm-s-calcium-borate-frit-on-1ttusd1: Calcium borate frit nke CTM, nke a na-ere ruo opekata mpe 2019, ma ''adịghị'' na December 2025. Nyocha a bụ nke ndepụta ọnụahịa CTM bipụtara site na 2016 ruo 2026 (otu ihe ahụ dịka Potterycrafts P2954); ibe weebụ frit nke CTM na-enye nke ochie karịa (SiO₂ 24, Al₂O₃ 8, B₂O₃ 41, CaO 22). CTM na-atụ aro, maka 100 g ọ bụla e wepụrụ n''usoro: gbakwunye 167 g Gillespie Borate na 10 g quartz, wepụkwa 12 g whiting na 26 g potash feldspar, wee nwalee.
not-classified-ctm-sds-37-avoid-o1fm3n: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (CTM SDS 37); zere iku uzuzu ya.
leadless-low-expansion-frit-small-additi: Frit na-enweghị lead nwere mgbasa dị ala; obere mgbakwunye na-eme ka glaze guzogide crazing karịa, ọtụtụ ya na-eme ka ọ chaa dịka mmiri ara ehi. Okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 1020-1150 °C (Bath Potters) ma ọ bụ 1040-1100 °C (Potclays). Akwụkwọ Potclays, na Bath Potters soro ya, bipụtara Li₂O 0.10, nke na-eme ka nyocha ahụ kwụsị na 99.0%. Formula Potclays n''onwe ya n''otu akwụkwọ ahụ (0.176 Li₂O) na-enye 1.06%, dịka Potterycrafts P2960 yiri ya nke ukwuu na-enye, ya mere e ji 1.1.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (SDS Potterycrafts P2960 nhata ya); zere iku uzuzu ya.
low-expansion-borax-frit-used-to-1bguah0: Borax frit nwere mgbasa dị ala, e ji ebelata mgbasa glaze ebe crazing bụ nsogbu; karịa ihe dị ka 5% ọ nwere ike ime ka elu ya ghara ịgbuke. Mgbasa 3.8 x 10^-6/°C, okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 1020-1150 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2960-b: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Potterycrafts SDS P2960); iku uzuzu ya ogologo oge na-eme ka ọrịa ngụgụ dịkwuo nso.
a-true-lead-bisilicate-65-66-1ics0hr: Lead bisilicate ''n''ezie'' (65-66% PbO, 32% SiO2, 2% Al2O3) a ka na-ere na UK dịka frit a na-ejikarị maka glaze earthenware nke na-adịghị agbaze nke ukwuu (low-solubility); ịgba ọkụ 880-1050 °C (Potclays).
lead-frit-toxic-if-the-dust-1fnhzt2: Lead (Pb) frit: nwere nsí ma ọ bụrụ na e kuru uzuzu ya ma ọ bụ loo ya. Glaze a gbara ọkụ nwere ike ịhapụ lead (Pb) banye na nri na ihe ọṅụṅụ; ndị na-ere ihe na UK kwuru na glaze low-solubility adịghị mma maka nri dịka ọ dị, a ghakwara inwale ihe ndị a kpụrụ maka metal ha na-ahapụ.
higher-lead-frit-1-pbo-to-1je72om: Frit nwere lead (Pb) dị elu karịa (1 PbO na 1.5 SiO2) nke Potclays na Bath Potters na-ere ''maka glaze nka ebe ọ dịghị mkpa ka ọ dị mma maka nri''. Okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ 860-1040 °C (Potclays).
lead-frit-toxic-if-the-dust-foqu21: Lead (Pb) frit: nwere nsí ma ọ bụrụ na e kuru uzuzu ya ma ọ bụ loo ya. Glaze a gbara ọkụ nwere ike ịhapụ lead (Pb) banye na nri na ihe ọṅụṅụ; ndị na-ere ihe na UK kwuru na glaze low-solubility adịghị mma maka nri dịka ọ dị, a ghakwara inwale ihe ndị a kpụrụ maka metal ha na-ahapụ. A na-ere ya n''ụzọ doro anya dịka ihe na-adịghị maka ihe na-emetụ nri.
uk-flint-is-calcined-flint-pebble-6yaur1: ''Flint'' na UK bụ okwute flint a gbara ọkụ (calcined), ọ bụghị quartz e gweriri: ihe dị ka 96% SiO2 ya na 1.3% CaO na 1.3% LOI. Valentine kwuru na ọ na-eme ka mgbasa n''okpomọkụ rịa elu ma a gbakwunye ya na glaze. Usoro US na-ekwu ''flint'' na-ekwu maka quartz e gweriri.
respirable-crystalline-silica-including-: Uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume (respirable crystalline silica), gụnyere ụfọdụ cristobalite; yiri respirator kwesịrị ekwesị.
the-potash-feldspar-that-most-german-mhg: Potash feldspar ọtụtụ ndị na-ere ihe ite na Germany na-ere (BSZ, Carl Jäger, Keramik-Kraft, Töpferbedarf Rantzau), nke Lehmhuus (Switzerland), keramik.at (Austria) na Solargil (France) na-erekwa. BSZ kwuru na ọ bụ ihe dị ka 72% potash feldspar, 23% soda feldspar na 2% quartz.
potterycrafts-p3296-data-sheet-october-2: Akwụkwọ data P3296 nke Potterycrafts (October 2025) na-enye nyocha a, ya mere o yiri ka a na-ere ya na UK dịka P3296.
sibelco-s-safety-data-sheet-2024-hx53ln: Akwụkwọ data nchekwa nke Sibelco (2024-03) edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ ma kwuo na quartz dị nro erughị 1%, ya na nepheline syenite ruo 25% n''ime ngwakọta ahụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
albite-soda-feldspar-from-sibelco-s-d39b: Albite soda feldspar si n''ụdị German nke Sibelco, nke Carl Jäger na BSZ na-ere dịka ''Feldspat Na LF 90'', Keramik-Kraft na-erekwa dịka ''Natron (Maxum/LA75)''. Ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ albite naanị, ya mere ọ na-agbaze tupu Norflux potash feldspar.
carl-ja-ger-s-safety-data-szccqx: Akwụkwọ data nchekwa nke Carl Jäger (2012) na-enye 1-3% quartz; uzuzu ya nwere ike inwe uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume. Zere iku ya.
potash-feldspar-sold-by-the-swiss-1jyw5l: Potash feldspar nke Bodmer Ton, onye na-ere ihe ite na Switzerland, na-ere, nwere ihe dị ka 10.7% K2O na 3% Na2O. Bodmer kwuru na ọ na-agbaze na 1250 °C.
soda-feldspar-mainly-albite-with-a-usgao: Soda feldspar (karịsịa albite) nwere ntakịrị quartz karịrị, nke Bodmer Ton na-ere na Switzerland. Bodmer kwuru na ọ na-agbaze na 1180 °C.
bodmer-labels-it-ghs08-health-hazard-yp1: Bodmer na-etinye ya akara GHS08 (ihe ize ndụ nye ahụ ike) n''ihi na uzuzu ya nwere uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume; zere iku ya.
spanish-potash-feldspar-from-imerys-s-1v: Potash feldspar si Spain, site n''ụlọ ọrụ Imerys dị na Onda, nke ọtụtụ ndị na-ere ihe ite na France na-ere (Ceradel, Solargil, Céram-Décor). Kemistri ya dị nso na G-200 EU, nke Imerys na-emepụta n''otu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ maka ahịa US.
imerys-s-safety-data-sheet-2013-15ms3kd: Akwụkwọ data nchekwa nke Imerys (2013) edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ ma kwuo na quartz a na-eku ume erughị 1%; zere iku uzuzu ya.
very-white-potash-feldspar-mostly-orthoc: Potash feldspar na-acha ọcha nke ukwuu, karịsịa orthoclase, nke Ceradel, onye na-ere ihe na France, na-ere; ihe dị ka 5% na-anọ n''elu ihe nyọ 44 µm.
a-blend-of-feldspars-with-more-1l53rzf: Ngwakọta feldspar nwere soda (6.9%) karịa potash (4.3%), nke Ceradel na-ere. Ọ nọ n''etiti soda feldspar na potash feldspar n''otu o si agbaze.
spanish-soda-feldspar-sold-to-potters-uj: Soda feldspar si Spain nke Prodesco na ụlọ ahịa na-edebe ngwaahịa ya (Marphil, Kádar) na-ere ndị ọkpụ ite, na France Solargil na-ere ya dịka ''Feldspath sodique FN72''. Prodesco kwuru na ọ bụ 61% albite, 7% orthoclase, 8% anorthite na 24% quartz, ya mere o nwere ọtụtụ free silica.
about-24-quartz-by-the-supplier-da180d: Ihe dị ka 24% quartz dịka nyocha mineral nke onye na-ere ya si kwuo, ya mere uzuzu ya nwere uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume; zere iku ya.
the-potash-feldspar-of-spain-s-7emvi0: Potash feldspar nke isi aha ihe eji arụ ite na Spain. N''agbanyeghị aha ya, o nwere naanị 7.5% K2O na 3.75% Na2O na silica karịrị, ya mere ọ bụ flux adịghị ike karịa ezigbo potash spar.
a-sodic-pegmatite-soda-feldspar-with-llp: Sodic pegmatite: soda feldspar nwere ọtụtụ quartz, a na-ere ndị ọkpụ ite na Spain. Ọ bụ flux siri ike, nwere silica karịa soda feldspar, a na-eji ya ntakịrị dịka Cornish stone.
high-in-free-quartz-about-75-1feyvbz: O nwere ọtụtụ free quartz (ihe dị ka 75% SiO2 n''ozuzu); uzuzu ya nwere uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume. Zere iku ya.
a-very-pure-potash-feldspar-86-zztdw5: Potash feldspar dị ọcha nke ukwuu (86% potash feldspar, 7% soda feldspar, 5% quartz dịka nyocha mineral nke onye na-ere ya si kwuo), nwere 14.5% K2O na Na2O erughị 1%, dị nso na orthoclase zuru oke. Sila Argille na Italy na-ere ya ndị ọkpụ ite.
swedish-feldspar-quartz-rock-from-sibelc: Nkume feldspar-quartz si Sweden, site n''ebe Sibelco na-egwu nkume na Forshammar, nwere soda na potash hà nhata na ọtụtụ free silica. A na-akpọ Forshammar feldspar aha n''ọtụtụ usoro stoneware ochie nke Sweden, mana ndị na-ere ihe ite na Sweden na UK na-ere Finnish FFF ma ọ bụ FFP 45 n''ọnọdụ ya ugbu a.
high-in-free-quartz-sio2-about-1h1npth: O nwere ọtụtụ free quartz (SiO2 ihe dị ka 76%); uzuzu ya nwere uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume. Zere iku ya.
washed-kaolin-from-the-old-zettlitz-1rbg: Kaolin a sachara asa si n''olulu ochie Zettlitz (Sedlec) dị nso Karlovy Vary, kaolinite karịrị 90%. Ọ bụ kaolin ntụaka nke kemistri seramiiki Germany ogologo oge, ya mere usoro na-achọ ''Zettlitzer Kaolin'' na-ekwu maka ihe a. A ka na-ere ya ndị ọkpụ ite maka glaze, engobe na porcelain.
kaolin-dust-may-contain-a-little-15eorz7: Uzuzu kaolin; o nwere ike inwe ntakịrị crystalline silica (quartz). Zere iku uzuzu ya.
the-plain-kaolin-that-bodmer-ton-hgczzf: ''Kaolin'' nkịtị nke Bodmer Ton, nnukwu onye na-ere ihe ite na Switzerland, na-ere n''akụkụ English china clay ya. Ọ dị ọkọ karịa ma nwee plasticity dị ala karịa Cornish china clay (naanị 19% dị nro karịa 2 microns), o nwekwara silica na potash karịa (2.9% K2O), ya mere ọ na-agbakwunye ntakịrị flux. A na-eji ya ewebata alumina na silica na glaze, na maka engobe ọcha.
kaolin-dust-german-washed-kaolins-usuall: Uzuzu kaolin; kaolin a sachara asa na Germany na-enwekarị ụfọdụ quartz dị nro. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
the-standard-kaolin-of-carl-ja-4uwzzt: ''Kaolin'' nkịtị nke Carl Jäger, nnukwu onye na-ere ihe ite na Germany nọ na Westerwald. Carl Jäger kọwara ya dịka nke na-acha ọcha nke ukwuu mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, maka glaze na ahụ ite, na-eme ka ike iguzogide ọkọ, ike iguzogide kemịkal na ịdị oke (viscosity) glaze rịa elu. Ihe e dere na Glazy gosiri na a na-erekwa ya na Belgium (Argilières Hins), Silica Nordic na Denmark na-erekwa kaolin nwere otu ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ.
carl-ja-ger-s-safety-data-a594dg: Akwụkwọ data nchekwa nke Carl Jäger (version 5, 30.01.2018) dere ya dịka ihe na-enweghị ihe ize ndụ mana kwuo na o nwere crystalline silica dị nro erughị 1%; zere ime uzuzu.
white-firing-breton-porcelain-kaolin-sol: Porcelain kaolin si Brittany na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, a na-ere ndị ọkpụ ite France dịka Kaolinor 1C (Ceradel) na ndị ọkpụ ite Spain dịka Caolín d''Arvor (Prodesco). Kaolin nkịtị, dị ọcha nke ọma maka glaze, engobe na ahụ porcelain.
ceradel-s-safety-sheet-dec-2024-ei419a: Akwụkwọ nchekwa Ceradel (Dec 2024) dere ya dịka 100% kaolin, nke edeghị dịka ihe ize ndụ; mesoo uzuzu ya dịka uzuzu ụrọ ọ bụla.
the-spanish-national-kaolin-that-spanish: Kaolin ''mba'' Spain nke ụlọ ahịa ihe ite na Spain (Prodesco, Marphil na Madrid) na-ere maka glaze, engobe na ahụ high-fire, n''ụzọ dị iche na English kaolin a na-ebubata. O nwere silica karịrị ntakịrị na potash dị obere karịa Cornish ma ọ bụ Breton kaolin.
kaolin-dust-may-contain-some-fine-14c37u: Uzuzu kaolin; o nwere ike inwe ụfọdụ quartz dị nro. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-light-firing-kaolinitic-westerwald-cla: Ụrọ Westerwald nwere kaolinite, na-acha ìhè mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ (46% kaolinite, 18% mica, 25% quartz), sitere n''otu n''ime ndị isi na-egwu ụrọ na Germany, a na-ere ya dịka ntụ ụrọ e gweriri. Nyocha ya na ịdị nro ya dị nso na English ball clay dịka TWVA (ihe dị ka 28% alumina, 11.6% LOI), ya mere ọ nwere ike ịnọchi otu na glaze na engobe.
contains-crystalline-silica-about-25-qua: O nwere crystalline silica (ihe dị ka 25% quartz dịka nyocha mineral nke onye mepụtara ya si kwuo); zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-german-westerwald-ball-clay-that-f3nfk: Ball clay German (Westerwald) nke Sibelco dere maka glaze na engobe: dị nnọọ nro (69% erughị 2 microns), na-acha ìhè mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, nwere ihe dị ka 24% alumina na 2.8% potash. Nyocha ya dị nso na English HVAR ball clay.
ball-clays-contain-free-quartz-avoid-hho: Ball clay nwere free quartz; zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-potassium-sodium-borosilicate-frit-wit: Potassium-sodium borosilicate frit nwere ọtụtụ alkali, sitere n''ụdị Frankfurt nke Vibrantz. Ọ bụ frit a na-ejikarị na Germany maka raku na glaze alkaline low-fire ndị ọzọ. Mgbasa bụ 150 x 10^-7/K (20-400 °C); ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 645 °C ma ruo ebe ọ ghọrọ ọkara okirikiri (half-sphere point) na 740 °C.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-16pz22p: Frit na-enweghị lead (iko, CAS 65997-18-4). Ahụghị SDS maka ngwaahịa a. Frit ndị yiri ya na-enweghị lead sitere na Mondré & Manz na Reimbold & Strick edeghị dịka ihe ize ndụ na SDS ha. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-no-wufbi: Sodium borosilicate frit na-enweghị alumina. Ọ bụ flux siri ike n''okpomọkụ dị ala na isi iyi boron. BSZ na-ere ya maka glaze alkaline na-enweghị lead, karịsịa raku, ọ dịkwa n''usoro crystalline glaze. Mgbasa bụ 85 x 10^-7/K; ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 685 °C ma ruo half-sphere point na 780 °C.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-g5r9m7: Frit na-enweghị lead (iko, CAS 65997-18-4) nwere ọtụtụ boron. Ahụghị SDS maka ngwaahịa a. Ụfọdụ ndị na-ere ihe na EU na-ede frit nwere ọtụtụ boron dịka ihe nwere nsí nye ịmụ nwa (H360FD), ya mere lelee SDS so akpa ahụ bịa. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-calcium-potassium-borosilicate-frit-so: Calcium-potassium borosilicate frit a na-ere dịka ''Basisfritte'' (frit ntọala). N''inwe ihe dị ka 12% alumina, kemistri ya dị nso na glaze zuru oke ma kwesị maka ntọala glaze earthenware doro anya na low stoneware. Mgbasa dị ala, 56 x 10^-7/K; ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 865 °C ma ruo half-sphere point na 1050 °C.
a-calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-little-: Calcium borosilicate frit nwere obere boron na ihe dị ka 12% alumina. Okpomọkụ ọ na-agbaze dị elu na-eme ka ọ kwesị maka glaze stoneware na earthenware a na-agba n''ọkụ dị elu karịa. Mgbasa bụ 76 x 10^-7/K; ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 830 °C ma ruo half-sphere point n''ihe dị ka 1080 °C. Hans Wolbring, keramikbedarf-online.de na Lehmhuus (Switzerland) na-ere ya.
a-zinc-barium-silicate-frit-with-gmr2om: Zinc-barium silicate frit na-enweghị boron, a na-eji maka glaze satin-matte na matte, na dịka ụzọ ịgbakwunye barium na zinc nke na-adịghị agbaze nke ukwuu. Mgbasa bụ ihe dị ka 103-105 x 10^-7/K; ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 835 °C ma ruo half-sphere point na 990 °C. BSZ, Hans Wolbring na keramikbedarf-online.de na-ere ya.
leadless-but-it-contains-about-35-ok0uml: Ọ nweghị lead, mana o nwere ihe dị ka 35% barium oxide na 19% zinc oxide jikọrọ n''ime iko. Ahụghị SDS. Barium dị na frit na-agbaze n''ụzọ dị obere nke ukwuu karịa barium carbonate, mana nwalee glaze ọ bụla nwere barium maka metal ndị na-apụta na ya (leach test) tupu e jiri ya n''elu ihe nri na-emetụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-low-expansion-sodium-borosilicate-frit: Sodium borosilicate frit nwere mgbasa dị ala: silica na boron dị elu, alkali dị obere. A na-agbakwunye frit nwere mgbasa dị ala dịka nke a na glaze iji belata mgbasa n''okpomọkụ ha ma gwọọ crazing. Naanị ya, ọ na-agbaze naanị n''okpomọkụ dị elu (half-sphere point 1270 °C). Mgbasa bụ 48 x 10^-7/K. Hans Wolbring na keramikbedarf-online.de na-ere ya.
a-calcium-alkali-borosilicate-frit-with-: Calcium-alkali borosilicate frit nwere ihe dị ka 11% alumina, a na-ere dịka ''Alkaliborfritte''. keramikbedarf-online.de na-ere ya maka oyi akwa na-egbochi (resist layer) na naked raku na dịka flux na glaze aventurine. Mgbasa bụ 65 x 10^-7/K; ọ na-amalite ịdị nro na 830 °C ma ruo half-sphere point na 970 °C.
a-soda-potash-lime-frit-with-52qvc2: Soda-potash-lime frit na-enweghị boron, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka o nweghị alumina. Mgbasa ya dị nnọọ elu: 141 x 10^-7/K, ọ na-adị nro na 503 °C. A na-eji ya maka glaze raku, crackle na crystalline, na maka alkaline blue na turquoise siri ike. Carl Jäger, BSZ, Keramik-Kraft, Hans Wolbring, Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na Ing. Lehrer (Austria) na-ere ya.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-1h3mmym: Frit na-enweghị lead (iko, CAS 65997-18-4). SDS Carl Jäger nyere maka frit Mondré & Manz a kwuru na edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru CLP. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-zinc-alkali-borosilicate-frit-rich-1ia: Zinc alkali borosilicate frit, nwere ọtụtụ potash, na mgbasa dị elu: 108 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro na 582 °C. A na-ere ya maka glaze matte, satin na crackle, na maka ime ka mgbasa glaze rịa elu. Carl Jäger, BSZ na Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na-ere ya.
a-leadless-alkali-frit-containing-lithiu: Alkali frit na-enweghị lead nwere lithium, zinc na calcium. Ndị na-ere ya kọwara ya dịka frit na-egbuke egbuke, nke boron mere ka ọ ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee (opacified), nwere surface tension dị elu, maka glaze doro anya, ọcha na glaze effect. Mgbasa bụ 65.9 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro na 680 °C. Carl Jäger, BSZ na Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na-ere ya.
a-leadless-borosilicate-frit-opacified-w: Borosilicate frit na-enweghị lead, nke zircon (7.5% ZrO2) mere ka ọ ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee, maka glaze ọcha. E mepụtara ya maka taịlị mgbidi earthenware a na-agba ọkụ ngwa ngwa. Mgbasa bụ 63 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro na 690 °C. Carl Jäger na Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na-ere ya.
a-leadless-sodium-borosilicate-frit-sold: Sodium borosilicate frit na-enweghị lead a na-ere maka glaze raku. Ndị na-ere ya na-atụkwa aro ya maka celadon na, ma a gbakwunye iron oxide, maka glaze aventurine. Mgbasa bụ 72.8 x 10^-7/K (20-400 °C), na-adị nro na 565 °C. Keramik-Kraft na Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na-ere ya.
a-calcium-borate-frit-with-very-cmvn8f: Calcium borate frit nwere silica dị nnọọ obere, e ji dịka isi iyi boron na calcium gbara ụkwụ. Ndị na-ere ihe na Germany na-ere ya dịka ihe nnọchi colemanite na Portabor nke na-ezere otu ha si eme ka glaze mmiri gbaa oke na otu ha si agba agba (spitting) na kiln. Mgbasa bụ 76.2 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro na 670 °C. keramikbedarf-online.de na Rantzauer Töpferbedarf na-ere ya.
a-barium-zinc-frit-that-contains-5y8sr8: Barium-zinc frit nwere 11% lead oxide; onye na-emepụta ya dere ya n''etiti lead frit ya. Keramik-Kraft na-ere ya naanị dịka ''Zinkbarium Fritte''. A na-eji ya maka glaze effect matte na crystalline. Mgbasa bụ 119 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro n''okpomọkụ karịrị 870 °C.
contains-lead-pbo-about-11-and-1wywyyz: O NWERE LEAD (Pb) (PbO ihe dị ka 11%) na barium (BaO ihe dị ka 38%). Keramik-Kraft dere H351 (a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-akpata kansa), H360FD (nwere ike imebi ike ịmụ nwa ma ọ bụ nwa nọ n''afọ), H362 (nwere ike imerụ ụmụaka na-aṅụ ara), H372 (na-emebi akụkụ ahụ ma a na-ezute ya ogologo oge) na H410 (nwere nsí dị ukwuu nye ihe ndị bi na mmiri). Ọ dabaghị maka ụlọ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ọrụ ntụrụndụ ma e nweghị njikwa kwesịrị ekwesị. Mee ka ụlọ nyocha (lab) nwalee glaze ọ bụla e ji ya mee maka lead (Pb) na barium ọ na-ahapụ tupu e jiri ya n''elu ihe nri ma ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ na-emetụ.
a-low-expansion-calcium-borosilicate-fri: Calcium borosilicate frit nwere mgbasa dị ala: mgbasa 42 x 10^-7/K, transformation 650 °C, ịdị nro 710 °C. Keramik-Kraft na-ere ya dịka ''Calziumborat Fritte'' na dịka ihe nnọchi colemanite. O nwere boron dị nnọọ obere na silica dị nnọọ ukwuu karịa ezigbo calcium borate frit.
leadless-frit-cas-65997-18-4-s12mq5: Frit na-enweghị lead (CAS 65997-18-4). SDS Reimbold & Strick a hụrụ maka frit yiri ya na-enweghị lead (A 3249 P, 2017) edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-calcium-borate-frit-with-one-awae2q: Calcium borate frit nwere otu CaO na otu B2O3, na-enweghị silica ma ọ bụ alumina; usoro Dutch na-akpọ ya ''calciumboraatfritte 3221''. Ọ bụ isi iyi boron gbara ụkwụ, n''ụdị kemịkal dịka colemanite na-enweghị mmiri. Keramikos, Cock Keramiek, Ve-Ka na De Beeldhouwwinkel na-ere ya.
leadless-keramikos-and-ve-ka-state-ngetf: Ọ nweghị lead. Keramikos na Ve-Ka kwuru na edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru CLP. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-zinc-borosilicate-frit-with-no-ua13zq: Zinc borosilicate frit na-enweghị alumina, nwere ihe dị ka 29% ZnO. Usoro Dutch na-eji ya agbakwunye zinc n''ụdị frit, maka effect agba matte, crystalline na nke dabere na zinc. Keramikos na Cock Keramiek na-ere ya.
leadless-keramikos-and-cock-keramiek-sta: Ọ nweghị lead. Keramikos na Cock Keramiek kwuru na edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-sodium-zinc-alkali-frit-with-o6mq1u: Sodium-zinc alkali frit na-enweghị boron, nwere obere alumina: ''alkalifritte 1510'' Dutch ama ama maka glaze alkaline dịka turquoise copper blue, raku na crackle. Keramikos na Ve-Ka (dịka ''Alkali 2495'') ka na-ere ya na 2026. Keramikos na-erekwa ''Alkali fritte 21.20'' ugbu a dịka ihe nnọchi ya.
leadless-keramikos-states-that-it-is-6gm: Ọ nweghị lead. Keramikos kwuru na edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru CLP. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
standard-lead-bisilicate-frit-pbo-2sio2-: Lead bisilicate frit nkịtị (PbO·2SiO2 nwere ntakịrị alumina) maka glaze earthenware a gbara n''ọkụ dị ala na majolica; ọ bụ onye nhata Dutch nke UK lead bisilicate. Cock Keramiek, Ve-Ka (dịka 3647) na De Beeldhouwwinkel (Keramikos 10.05) na-ere ya.
contains-lead-pbo-about-65-cock-7wgj88: O NWERE LEAD (Pb) (PbO ihe dị ka 65%). Cock Keramiek tinyere ya akara ''Gevaarlijke stof''. E dere lead (Pb) frit na EU dịka Repr. 1A na STOT RE 1. SDS Reimbold & Strick maka lead frit ya A 1316 P dere: H302+H332 (na-emerụ ahụ ma e loo ya ma ọ bụ kuru ya), H351 (a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-akpata kansa), H360Df (nwere ike imebi nwa nọ n''afọ; a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-emebi ike ịmụ nwa), H372 (na-emebi akụkụ ahụ ma a na-ezute ya ogologo oge) na H410 (nwere nsí dị ukwuu nye ihe ndị bi na mmiri). Mee ka ụlọ nyocha (lab) nwalee glaze ọ bụla e ji ya mee maka lead (Pb) ọ na-ahapụ tupu e jiri ya n''elu ihe nri ma ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ na-emetụ.
lead-monosilicate-frit-one-pbo-to-yl6thf: Lead monosilicate frit (otu PbO na otu SiO2), frit nkịtị kacha nwee lead (Pb). Ọ bụ flux siri ike nke ukwuu n''okpomọkụ dị ala maka glaze earthenware na raku. Mgbasa bụ ihe dị ka 89-90 x 10^-7/K, na-adị nro n''ihe dị ka 450-470 °C. Ve-Ka (Netherlands, dịka 2994) na-ere ya ndị ọkpụ ite. Ing. Lehrer (Austria) na-ebipụta SDS 2019 maka R&S A 1316 P.
contains-lead-pbo-about-79-reimbold-t25l: O NWERE LEAD (Pb) (PbO ihe dị ka 79%). SDS Reimbold & Strick maka A 1316 P (rev. 1.07, 2019) dere ya dịka Repr. 1A na STOT RE 1: H302+H332 (na-emerụ ahụ ma e loo ya ma ọ bụ kuru ya), H351 (a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-akpata kansa), H360Df (nwere ike imebi nwa nọ n''afọ; a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-emebi ike ịmụ nwa), H372 (na-emebi akụkụ ahụ ma a na-ezute ya ogologo oge) na H410 (nwere nsí dị ukwuu nye ihe ndị bi na mmiri). Jiri ya naanị na njikwa uzuzu, uwe aka (gloves) na ịdị ọcha dị mma. Mee ka ụlọ nyocha (lab) nwalee glaze ọ bụla e ji ya mee maka lead (Pb) ọ na-ahapụ tupu e jiri ya n''elu ihe nri ma ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ na-emetụ.
water-washed-primary-kaolin-from-pittong: Primary kaolin e ji mmiri saa si Pittong dị nso Ballarat, naanị ụlọ ọrụ hydrous kaolin dị n''Australia; china clay nkịtị nke Australia maka glaze na ahụ ite ọcha. Walker Ceramics (BA330), Pottery Supplies Online, The Potter''s Market na ndị ọzọ na-ere ya.
sds-suvo-minerals-australia-eckalite-1-1: SDS (Suvo Minerals Australia, Eckalite 1 & 1 Plus, 2024): kaolin >98%, crystalline silica (quartz) <1%. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-second-pittong-kaolin-grade-slightly-1: Ụdị Pittong kaolin nke abụọ, nwere iron karịrị ntakịrị Eckalite 1; Walker Ceramics (BA331, nke nọchiri Eckaglas ha), Northcote Pottery Supplies na Blackwattle Pottery na-ere ya ndị ọkpụ ite. A na-eji ya maka alumina glaze, ijide glaze n''ime mmiri na slip. Ọnụ ọgụgụ Walker bụ ndị o nyere na 2007 maka Eckaglas, ụdị nke a nọchiri.
kaolin-the-related-eckalite-1-sds-57l3rd: Kaolin; SDS Eckalite 1 metụtara ya (2024) na-enye quartz <1%. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
very-white-low-iron-low-titania-1uwzzja: Halloysite na-acha ọcha nke ukwuu, nwere iron dị ala na titania dị ala (ụrọ ezinụlọ kaolin) e kewapụtara site na rhyolite gbanwere agbanwe na Matauri Bay; a na-eji ya maka porcelain ìhè na-agafe na glaze doro anya nke ukwuu. Walker Ceramics (BA139) na-ere ya n''Australia, a na-erekwa ya na US dịka ''Kaolin New Zealand''.
kaolin-group-clay-with-fine-tubular-1t37: Ụrọ ezinụlọ kaolin nwere mkpụrụ dị nro dị ka ọkpọkọ; nkume nne ya bụ quartz na cristobalite, ntakịrị ha nwekwara ike ịfọdụ (XRD nke akwụkwọ ozi ahụ gosiri ha abụọ). Zere iku uzuzu ya.
dry-milled-very-plastic-secondary-clay-7: Secondary clay e gweriri n''enweghị mmiri, nwere plasticity nke ukwuu, si n''olulu Claypro n''onwe ya dị na Axedale, Victoria; Australian ball clay a na-ere ndị ọkpụ ite dịka CA1 (Northcote) na CA2 (Walker, Blackwattle). A na-eji ya maka plasticity n''ahụ ite, na maka ijide glaze n''ime mmiri, silica na alumina na glaze.
claypro-sds-2015-about-20-crystalline-2r: Claypro SDS (2015): ihe dị ka 20% crystalline silica (quartz); e dere ya dịka Carcinogen Category 1A (H350, site n''iku ume). Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-plastic-white-firing-kaolinitic-clay-1: Ụrọ nwere kaolinite, nwere plasticity, na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ, nwere àgwà ọrụ dịka ball clay, e mere iji dochie Cresta BB na BB4 ochie; ọ dị n''usoro Australia ochie dịka ''Clay Ceram''. Walker Ceramics tinyere ya akara ''adịghịzi''.
walker-ceramics-already-listed-it-as-1ni: Walker Ceramics edelarị ya dịka ihe na-adịghịzi n''October 2016.
unimin-tds-contains-free-crystalline-sil: Unimin TDS: o nwere free crystalline silica (quartz). Zere iku uzuzu ya.
a-thai-potash-feldspar-of-the-1yw5cs8: Potash feldspar si Thailand nke ụdị a na-ere ugbu a dịka ''potash feldspar'' n''Australia; Walker Ceramics dere BA350 ya dịka nke si Thailand, SDS Blackwattle na-akpọkwa ''Potash Feldspar K200BL'' (Scott Chemicals). sds-for-potash-feldspar-k200bl-scott-190: SDS maka Potash Feldspar K200BL (Scott Chemicals, 2021): feldspar 90-98%, quartz 2-10%. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
albite-type-soda-feldspar-imported-from-: Soda feldspar ụdị albite e si India bubata, nke Walker Ceramics na Blackwattle Pottery na-ere; flux na-egbuke egbuke karịa, na-agbaze n''okpomọkụ dị ntakịrị ala karịa potash feldspar maka glaze stoneware na mid-fire. walker-msds-2019-soda-feldspar-98-1phdzl: Walker MSDS (2019): soda feldspar >98%, e dekwara quartz dịka akụkụ nwere ihe ize ndụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya.
walker-s-fluorine-free-blend-of-1i67hb4: Ngwakọta mineral na-enweghị fluorine nke Walker, e mere ka o kwekọọ na Cornish stone dị n''okike; Walker kọwara ya dịka flux adịghị ike ntakịrị karịa feldspar, maka usoro na-achọ Cornish stone. no-sds-reviewed-as-a-feldspar-19nqyax: Elebaghị SDS anya. Dịka ngwakọta ụdị feldspar na quartz, ọ ga-enwe crystalline silica; zere iku uzuzu ya.
milled-quartz-flour-about-90-finer-lnsq1: Ntụ quartz e gweriri (ihe dị ka 90% dị nro karịa 45 microns) si n''ọrụ Sibelco dị na Lang Lang; ''Silica 200#'' nke Walker (BA770), Keane, Northcote na Blackwattle na-ere. SDS Walker na-akpọ usoro Sibelco WQ.
sibelco-sds-milled-silica-products-2011-: Sibelco SDS (ngwaahịa silica e gweriri, 2011): quartz 99%, uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume karịrị 20%. Iku ya ogologo oge na-akpata silicosis (ọrịa ngụgụ) na kansa ngụgụ; zere iku uzuzu ya.
lead-free-high-soda-high-expansion-4gjtq: Frit na-enweghị lead (lead-free), nwere soda dị elu na mgbasa dị elu, ya na ntakịrị boron. walker-ceramics-listed-it-until-february: Walker Ceramics dere ya ruo February 2020, mana o deghịzi ya na March 2021.
no-sds-seen-frit-is-a-t89ijb: Ahụghị SDS. Frit bụ iko e gweriri na-enweghị free crystalline silica; zere iku uzuzu ya dị nro.
lead-free-calcium-borosilicate-frit-ferr: Calcium borosilicate frit na-enweghị lead (lead-free), ụdị Ferro Australia nke US Frit 3124 mana nwere alumina dị obere. soft-lead-free-high-calcium-borosilicate: Borosilicate frit dị nro, na-enweghị lead (lead-free), nwere calcium dị elu. medium-hard-lead-free-calcium-sodium-1da: Calcium-sodium borosilicate frit siri ike nke etiti, na-enweghị lead (lead-free), maka glaze doro anya. hard-lead-free-clear-borosilicate-frit-1: Borosilicate frit siri ike, na-enweghị lead (lead-free), doro anya maka earthenware na 1040-1100°C (Walker; mgbasa 69 x10^-7). alumina-free-lead-free-sodium-calcium-4v: Sodium-calcium borosilicate frit na-enweghị alumina, na-enweghị lead (lead-free), maka earthenware na 1040-1100°C (Walker; mgbasa 83 x10^-7). standard-low-solubility-lead-bisilicate-: Lead bisilicate frit nkịtị nke na-adịghị agbaze nke ukwuu (low-solubility) (ihe dị ka 65% lead oxide) maka glaze earthenware na-egbuke egbuke na 950-1050°C (Walker; mgbasa 72 x10^-7). lead-frit-about-65-lead-oxide-1r8qgke: LEAD (Pb) FRIT: ihe dị ka 65% lead oxide, jikọrọ n''ime iko. dense-lead-free-zircon-opacified-white-1: Frit ọcha siri ike (dense), na-enweghị lead (lead-free), nke zircon mere ka ọ ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee (ihe dị ka 12% ZrO2) maka glaze earthenware ọcha na pastel na 1040-1100°C (Walker; mgbasa 59 x10^-7). no-sds-seen-frit-is-a-btjxa5: Ahụghị SDS. Frit bụ iko e gweriri na-enweghị free crystalline silica. O nwere zirconium na zinc oxide n''ime iko ahụ. Zere iku uzuzu ya dị nro.
a-leadless-very-low-expansion-calcium-zq: Calcium-barium borosilicate frit na-enweghị lead, nwere mgbasa dị nnọọ ala (mgbasa 40 x 10^-7/K), nwere silica na boron dị elu. A na-agbakwunye frit nwere mgbasa dị ala otú a n''obere ọnụ iji belata mgbasa glaze ma gwọọ crazing. Naanị ya, ọ siri ike (ịdị nro 910 °C, half-sphere point 1280 °C). Hans Wolbring (Höhr-Grenzhausen, Germany) na-ere ya.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-1jelw38: Frit na-enweghị lead (iko, CAS 65997-18-4) nwere ihe dị ka 6% barium oxide na 22% boron oxide jikọrọ n''ime iko. Ahụghị SDS maka ngwaahịa a. Ụfọdụ ndị na-ere ihe na EU na-ede frit nwere ọtụtụ boron dịka ihe nwere nsí nye ịmụ nwa (H360FD), ya mere lelee SDS so akpa ahụ bịa. Zere iku uzuzu ya.

pr6o11-the-dark-brown-form-that-n56z4j: Pr₆O₁₁, ụdị na-acha nchara nchara gbara ọchịchịrị a na-ere. A na-agụ ya ebe a dịka Pr₂O₃, ụdị praseodymium na-ewere na glaze; oxygen karịrị (3.1%) na mmiri ruo 1% na-agụ dịka loss on ignition. Ọ naghị agbaze na kiln (ihe dị ka 2183 C); 931 C a na-ekwukarị bụ maka metal ahụ. Ihe na-enye agba adịghị ike: 5–8% na-enye agba akwụkwọ ndụ lime ruo akwụkwọ ndụ odo, a na-ejikarị ya na zircon-praseodymium yellow stain.
low-hazard-but-sdss-disagree-fujifilm-d1: Obere ihe ize ndụ, mana SDS ekwekọrịtaghị: Fujifilm Wako (2023) adịghị ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS; LTS (2023) Ịdọ aka na ntị, H315, H319, H335 (mgbakasị akpụkpọ ahụ, anya na akụkụ iku ume). Ọtụtụ ndị na-ezite ozi na ECHA edeghị praseodymium oxide dịka ihe ize ndụ.
natural-rutile-milled-for-ceramics-about: Rutile dị n''okike e gweriri maka seramiiki: ihe dị ka 95% TiO2 ya na obere silica, zircon, vanadium, iron na chromium. Ụdị US na UK nke ugbu a nwere iron oxide erughị 1%, ọ bụghị 9–10% a na-echekarị. A na-eji ya maka agba tan ruo nchara nchara gbasara agbasa (variegation), ime ka ọ ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee na uto crystal, na ya na cobalt, copper ma ọ bụ iron maka agba gbajiri agbaji (broken colours).
tam-ceramics-sds-2018-warning-eye-1yrsyy: TAM Ceramics SDS (2018): Ịdọ aka na ntị, na-akpasu anya na akpụkpọ ahụ (Category 2; H319, H315); uzuzu nwere ike ịkpasu ụzọ iku ume. Potterycrafts SDS: edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ. E kagburu ndepụta Carc. 2 nke EU maka ntụ TiO2 a na-eku ume (2022, e kwadoro ya 2025).
tio2-added-at-about-2-10-wa6in9: TiO₂. A na-agbakwunye ya n''ihe dị ka 2–10% (4% bụ nke a na-ahụkarị) maka variegation, ime ka ọ ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee na uto crystal, na ya na iron ma ọ bụ cobalt maka agba gbajiri agbaji. Ọ dịkwa na ndepụta ihe eji arụ ọrụ dịka Titanium Oxide, maka usoro na-agụ ya na ntọala.
vanadium-pentoxide-v2o5-an-orange-yellow: Vanadium pentoxide, V2O5, ntụ na-acha oroma-odo, ihe dị ka 99% dị ọcha. Ọ na-agbaze na 690 C (1274 F) ma na-arụ ọrụ dịka flux; naanị ya ọ na-enye odo ruo nchara nchara adịghị ike, ya na tin oxide ma ọ bụ zircon ọ na-enye odo siri ike karịa. Nwere nsí nke ukwuu: yiri respirator, zere uzuzu ma mee ka ikuku si na kiln pụọ.
danger-eu-gb-harmonised-classification-h: Ihe ize ndụ. Nhazi EU/GB jikọrọ ọnụ: H301 nwere nsí ma e loo ya, H330 na-egbu mmadụ ma e kuru ya, H335 mgbakasị akụkụ iku ume, H341 a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-akpata mmebi mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa, H350 nwere ike ịkpata kansa, H361fd a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-emebi ike ịmụ nwa ma ọ bụ nwa nọ n''afọ, H362 mmerụ nye ụmụaka na-aṅụ ara, H372 mmebi ngụgụ site n''izute ya ugboro ugboro, H411 nwere nsí nye ihe ndị bi na mmiri. SDS US na-enye usoro dị ntakịrị nro mana ka dị njọ (H302+H332, H319, H335, H341, H351, H361, H372, H411).
stannic-oxide-sno2-about-99-5-14e5t2w: Stannic oxide, SnO₂, ihe dị ka 99.5% dị ọcha. Ọ naghị agbaze n''okpomọkụ glaze (ọ na-agbaze n''ihe dị ka 1630 C / 2966 F); ọ na-anọ n''ime ya dịka mkpụrụ dị nro, nke na-eme ka glaze ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee: 4–6% na-enye ọcha nke na-ahụ ụzọ ntakịrị, 8–10% enweghị ịhụ ụzọ kpamkpam, na ọcha na-ekpo ọkụ na majolica a gbara n''ọkụ dị ala. Ọ naghị eme ka glaze ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee nke ọma na reduction na na cone 10, ebe ọ na-amalite ịgbaze. Ọ na-enyere copper red aka ịpụta na reduction; ya na ntakịrị chrome ọ na-aghọ pink.
not-classified-no-signal-word-on-n0mh1: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (enweghị okwu ịdọ aka na ntị) na SDS nke ugbu a (Potterycrafts 2025, Laguna 2014). Iku uzuzu ya ọtụtụ afọ nwere ike ịkpata stannosis, ọnọdụ ngụgụ na-adịghị njọ (benign).
zirconium-dioxide-zro2-zirconia-rarely-u: Zirconium dioxide, ZrO₂ (zirconia). A naghị ejikarị ya otú ọ dị na glaze: ọtụtụ usoro na-achọ zircon (Zircopax, Superpax), nke bụ zirconium silicate. Anaghị agbaze na mmiri; ọ na-eme ka glaze ghara ikwe ka ìhè gafee ka ọ na-anọ n''agbazeghị n''okpomọkụ glaze, na-eme ka ihe gbazere sie ike ma nwee ike ibelata crazing.
not-classified-ati-zirconium-oxide-sds-1: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (ATI zirconium oxide SDS, EU); zere iku uzuzu ya.
zirconium-silicate-zrsio4-67-2-zro2-i6z2: Zirconium silicate, ZrSiO₄: 67.2% ZrO₂ na 32.8% SiO₂. A na-ere ya dịka Zircopax, Superpax, Excelopax, Ultrox na Zircosil, ndị dị iche karịsịa na nha mkpụrụ. Opacifier a na-ejikarị: ihe dị ka 4–7% maka nke na-ahụ ụzọ ntakịrị, 8–15% ma ọ bụ karịa maka enweghị ịhụ ụzọ kpamkpam; 1–3% na-eme ka glaze sie ike karịsịa. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ na reduction, n''adịghị ka tin oxide. A na-agụ silica ya n''ime glaze.
not-classified-ctm-zirconium-silicate-sd: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (CTM zirconium silicate SDS 29; uzuzu crystalline silica a na-eku ume erughị 0.01%); o nwere ntakịrị radioactivity (uranium 285–343 ppm, thorium 116–157 ppm), ya mere zere iku uzuzu ya.
synthetic-red-iron-oxide-is-about-1i5e3s: Synthetic red iron oxide bụ ihe dị ka 99% Fe₂O₃; red iron oxide dị n''okike (hematite e gweriri) adịghị ike karịa, ihe dị ka 76–95% Fe₂O₃ ya na ụrọ, quartz na carbonate. Ọ na-eme ka glaze kwụsie ike, na-eguzogide ọkụ na oxidation ruo ihe dị ka cone 7–8, ebe ọ na-amalite efu oxygen ghọọ flux; na reduction ọ na-aghọ FeO n''oge ma bụrụ flux siri ike.
synthetic-grade-not-classified-as-hazard: Ụdị e mepụtara emepụta (synthetic): edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Potterycrafts SDS P3441, rev 2025-10). Ụdị nkume dị n''okike nwere akara Ịdọ aka na ntị, H373 (mmebi ngụgụ site n''iku ya ogologo oge) n''ihi na ha nwere quartz a na-eku ume.
wyoming-sodium-bentonite-the-standard-gl: Wyoming sodium bentonite, ihe a na-ejikarị ejide glaze n''ime mmiri; 1–3% na-egbochi glaze ịnọdụ ala, mana karịa nke ahụ na-eme ka ọ kpọọ nkụ nwayọọ ma nwee ike ịkpata crawling. Ọ na-agbakwunye ntakịrị iron, soda na magnesia.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-qzjuvp: Ihe ize ndụ: H350 nwere ike ịkpata kansa (site n''iku ume) na H372 na-emebi ngụgụ ma a na-ezute ya ogologo oge ma ọ bụ ugboro ugboro, n''ihi na o nwere crystalline silica (Volclay 325: quartz ruo 6%, cristobalite ruo 2%). Zere iku uzuzu.
a-water-washed-white-firing-smectite-11s: Smectite clay e ji mmiri saa, na-acha ọcha mgbe a gbara ya ọkụ (magnesium aluminium silicate), a na-eji na 1–2% dịka ihe na-ejide glaze n''ime mmiri ma na-eme ka ọ sie ike, na dịka ihe na-enye plasticity maka porcelain na ahụ ite ndị ọzọ na-enweghị plasticity. Mee ka ọ ṅụjuo mmiri kpamkpam tupu ị gbakwunye ihe ndị ọzọ. Vanderbilt ebipụtaghị nyocha oxide maka ụdị T; nke a bụ nke VEEGUM nkịtị, e hotara n''otu patent nke 1964, ya mere were ya dịka ihe dị nso. O nwere ọtụtụ magnesium (MgO 13.7%), n''adịghị ka sodium bentonite.
not-classified-vanderbilt-sds-2023-no-17: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Vanderbilt SDS 2023): enweghị okwu ịdọ aka na ntị. Zere iku uzuzu; iku ya ogologo oge nwere ike imerụ ngụgụ.
a-purified-hectorite-magnesium-lithium-s: Hectorite clay a sachara ọcha (magnesium-lithium smectite), nke a na-ere ugbu a dịka Elementis Bentone MA; ọ na-ejide glaze n''ime mmiri ma na-eme ka oyi akwa kpọrọ nkụ sie ike n''emeghị ka ọ kpọọ nkụ nwayọọ dịka CMC. N''adịghị ka bentonite, ọ na-ewete magnesia, lime na ntakịrị lithia kama alumina na iron.
not-classified-elementis-sds-2016-not-j7: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Elementis SDS 2016): ọ bụghị ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS. Zere iku uzuzu.
an-organic-gum-that-binds-and-pg9ere: Gum organic nke na-ejikọ ma na-eme ka oyi akwa glaze kpọrọ nkụ sie ike, na-eme ka ọ kpọọ nkụ nwayọọ ma na-enyere aka n''iji brush tee ya; ọ na-ere ọkụ pụọ mgbe a na-agba ọkụ, a naghịkwa agụ ya na kemistri. Ihe e ji ya mee na mmiri na-emebi, ya mere mee obere batch ma ọ bụ gbakwunye ihe na-echekwa ya (preservative).
warning-may-form-combustible-dust-concen: Ịdọ aka na ntị: o nwere ike ịmepụta uzuzu na-ere ọkụ n''ikuku (OSHA combustible dust). Enweghị nhazi ihe ize ndụ nye ahụ ike.
a-soluble-salt-used-in-tiny-1g4n6wq: Nnu na-agbaze na mmiri a na-eji n''obere ọnụ iji mee ka glaze mmiri (slurry) gbaa oke (flocculate) ka o wee nọrọ n''ime mmiri; ọ bụ mgbanwe usoro ọrụ, ọ bụghị n''ezie ihe mejupụtara glaze. Ọtụtụ n''ime ịdị arọ ya bụ mmiri na sulfate, ndị na-apụ mgbe a na-agba ọkụ.
not-classified-giles-chemical-sds-2020-1: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Giles Chemical SDS 2020): ọ bụghị ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS.
manganese-ii-carbonate-a-pinkish-tan-nrm: Manganese(II) carbonate, ntụ na-acha pinkish-tan; ụdị a na-ere n''ahịa bụ ihe dị ka 44% manganese (MnCO3 dị ọcha bụ 47.8%). A na-agụ ya dịka MnO, ihe dị ka 57% MnO ya na ihe dị ka 43% loss on ignition ka ọ na-ahapụ CO2 site n''ihe dị ka 200 C; ọ na-enye nchara nchara, na purple ruo plum na glaze alkaline.
danger-h372-causes-damage-to-organs-18gj: Ihe ize ndụ: H372, na-emebi akụkụ ahụ (akwara ozi) ma a na-eku ya ogologo oge ma ọ bụ ugboro ugboro (Laguna SDS, rev. 2014-03; nakwa ozi ECHA a kacha ahụ). Zere uzuzu ya ma mee ka ikuku si na kiln pụọ.
basic-nickel-carbonate-a-light-green-14r: Basic nickel carbonate, ntụ na-acha akwụkwọ ndụ dị ìhè a na-ere n''ihe dị ka 46% nickel. A na-agụ ya dịka NiO, ihe dị ka 58.5% NiO ya na ihe dị ka 41.5% loss on ignition; gas ọ na-ahapụ nwere ike ime ka glaze nwee afụ (blister). Ọ na-enye agba akwụkwọ ndụ, grey na nchara nchara dị jụụ, a na-ejikwa ya eme ka cobalt blue dị nro.
danger-h302-h332-harmful-if-swallowed-1e: Ihe ize ndụ: H302+H332 na-emerụ ahụ ma e loo ya ma ọ bụ kuru ya; H315; H317 na-akpata allergy akpụkpọ ahụ; H334 na-akpata allergy iku ume; H341; H350i nwere ike ịkpata kansa site n''iku ume; H360 nwere ike imebi ike ịmụ nwa ma ọ bụ nwa nọ n''afọ; H372. Nhazi EU jikọrọ ọnụ na-enye H360D (nwere ike imebi nwa nọ n''afọ) ma gbakwunye H400/H410 (ihe bi na mmiri). Zere uzuzu ya niile.
sold-to-potters-as-ground-natural-1ijf67: A na-ere ya ndị ọkpụ ite dịka chromite ore dị n''okike e gweriri si South Africa, ọ bụghị ezigbo chromate: ihe dị ka 46% Cr2O3 na 26% FeO, ya na alumina na magnesia. Ọ na-eguzogide ọkụ nke ukwuu; ọ na-enye grey, nchara nchara ya na zinc, pink ruo uhie ya na tin, na ojii ya na cobalt.
not-classified-under-ghs-vibrantz-iron-h: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS (Vibrantz ''Iron Chromite Chromox 7901'' SDS, rev. 2023-01, dịka Sounding Stone na-ere; nakwa Prince Minerals SDS maka Laguna). Zere iku uzuzu ya; akwụkwọ ochie ndị ọkpụ ite na-akpọ ya ihe nwere nsí nke ukwuu.
a-rare-earth-oxide-used-as-1yx4z2x: Rare-earth oxide a na-eji dịka opacifier n''okpomọkụ dị ala na ihe na-enye agba adịghị ike, na-enye cream ruo tan-odo ma ọ bụ oroma karịsịa ya na titanium ma ọ bụ rutile. Ọ na-anọdụ ala ngwa ngwa, ya mere glaze ahụ chọrọ ihe na-ejide ya n''ime mmiri.
not-classified-pace-sds-2025-not-1ao5xnh: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (PACE SDS 2025): ọ bụghị ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS. Ụfọdụ ndị na-ere ya dere mgbakasị anya, akpụkpọ ahụ na akụkụ iku ume (H315, H319, H335). Zere iku uzuzu.
natural-red-iron-oxide-mined-at-767hen: Red iron oxide dị n''okike e gwuru na Tierga, Spain: ihe dị ka 87% Fe2O3 ya na ụfọdụ silica, dolomite na mica, ya mere gram maka gram ọ dị ntakịrị adịghị ike karịa synthetic red iron oxide. Ọ na-acha oroma-uhie na-egbuke mgbe a na-agbaghị ya ọkụ; o nwere ụfọdụ nnu na-agbaze na mmiri.
warning-h373-may-cause-damage-to-1vkarkk: Ịdọ aka na ntị: H373, nwere ike imebi ngụgụ ma a na-eku ya ogologo oge ma ọ bụ ugboro ugboro, n''ihi na o nwere quartz a na-eku ume (Promindsa Micronox R series SDS, rev. 2015-01, nke Laguna na-ekesa).
fine-silicon-carbide-about-600-mesh-vaaz: Silicon carbide dị nro (ihe dị ka 600 mesh, FFF) na-enye reduction n''otu ebe n''ịgba ọkụ oxidation, dịka maka copper red; ọtụtụ ya ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ka ọkọ na-eme elu nwere afụ na oghere. A naghị agụ ya na kemistri, ọ bụ ezie na ọ bụrụ na o rechara ọkụ kpamkpam ọ ga-aghọ silica ihe dị ka ugboro 1.5 nke ịdị arọ ya.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-15vqfe: Ihe ize ndụ: H350 nwere ike ịkpata kansa (site n''iku ume), n''ihi ntakịrị crystalline silica (Washington Mills SDS 2025). SDS ochie ndị na-ere ya dekwara mgbakasị akpụkpọ ahụ, anya na akụkụ iku ume (H315, H319, H335). Zere iku uzuzu.
commercial-stains-are-pre-fired-insolubl: Stain a na-ere n''ahịa bụ pigment a gbaburu ọkụ, na-adịghị agbaze na mmiri; ihe mejupụtara ha bụ ihe nzuzo nke onye mepụtara ha, ha na-enyekwa iko agba site n''ịnọ n''ime ya n''agbazeghị, ya mere a naghị agụ ha na kemistri. Lelee ndetu onye mepụtara ya maka stain ọ bụla: ụfọdụ achọghị zinc, ụfọdụ chọrọ calcium dị elu, nke ọ bụla nwekwara okpomọkụ ịgba ọkụ kacha elu.
varies-by-stain-check-the-sds-rfi082: Ọ dịgasị iche site n''otu stain gaa na nke ọzọ: lelee SDS maka stain ahụ kpọmkwem. SDS Mason dere ọtụtụ stain (dịka 6600 Best Black) dịka ihe edeghị dịka ihe ize ndụ, mana stain nwere ike inwe cobalt, nickel, chromium, manganese, vanadium, praseodymium ma ọ bụ cadmium/selenium (inclusion red na orange). Zere iku uzuzu.
crocus-martis-sold-by-us-suppliers-nv7ve: Crocus martis nke ndị na-ere ihe na US na-ere taa bụ synthetic red iron oxide e gweriri nke ọma (Bayferrox 180) nwere ntakịrị agba blue-purple, ọ bụghị calcined iron sulfate ochie. Jiri ya dịka red iron oxide; usoro e dere maka ụdị ochie nwere sulfate jiri ọtụtụ ya karịa, n''ihi na ụdị ahụ na-efu ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n''ụzọ ise nke ịdị arọ ya mgbe a na-agba ọkụ.
not-classified-as-hazardous-lanxess-bayf: Edeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ (Lanxess Bayferrox 180 M data; red iron oxide pigment). Uzuzu na-enye nsogbu; Laguna SDS ochie kwuru ihe dị ka 4% amorphous silica.
natural-iron-titanium-ore-sold-as-owmfed: Iron-titanium ore dị n''okike a na-ere dịka mkpụrụ hà ka ájá (ihe dị ka 30–270 mesh) iji nye ntụpọ nchara nchara gbara ọchịchịrị na glaze na ahụ ụrọ. Ụdị a bụ ilmenite gbanwere agbanwe, ihe dị ka 64% TiO2 na 29% iron oxide; mkpụrụ ndị ahụ anaghị agbaze kpamkpam, ya mere kemistri a gụrụ na-ekwubiga ihe na-abanye n''iko ahụ ókè.
not-classified-under-ghs-prince-minerals: Edebeghị ya dịka ihe ize ndụ n''okpuru GHS (Prince Minerals ''Granular Ilmenite'' SDS, rev. 2014-10, nke Laguna na Axner na-ekesa); o nwere quartz ruo 0.5%.
bentonite-sold-by-carl-ja-ger-lwhw4v: Bentonite nke Carl Jäger (Germany) na Bodmer Ton (Switzerland) na-ere, nke Silica Nordic (Denmark) na-erekwa na otu nyocha ahụ: montmorillonite clay na-aza (swelling) a na-eji na 0.5-2% (ruo 3%) iji jide glaze n''ime mmiri ma mee ka oyi akwa glaze a na-agbaghị ọkụ sie ike. O nwere lime (6% CaO) karịa nke ukwuu na silica dị ala karịa sodium bentonite America (Volclay), ya mere jiri ndekọ a mgbe usoro Europe na-achọ ''Bentonit''.
bentonite-dust-may-contain-crystalline-s: Uzuzu bentonite nwere ike inwe crystalline silica (quartz ma ọ bụ cristobalite); zere iku uzuzu ya.
white-low-iron-bentonite-sold-by-kd46hw: Bentonite ọcha nwere iron dị ala nke ndị na-ere ihe ite na Spain (Prodesco, Marphil) na-ere dịka ihe na-ejide glaze n''ime mmiri na ihe na-enye plasticity. Akwụkwọ ahụ kwuru na ọ bụ ihe dị ka 80% montmorillonite na 17% opal-C/cristobalite, nke na-akọwa silica ya dị nnọọ elu.
